title: DLP Engineer
summary: A DLP engineer stops sensitive data leaving the company by building and tuning data loss prevention rules (DLP). They sit in the security or data protection team, running tools like Microsoft Purview, Forcepoint or Symantec across email, endpoints and cloud apps and triaging the incidents these raise.
dailyDuties: Build and tune DLP policies across email, endpoints and cloud
Deploy and manage endpoint DLP agents across the fleet
Set up sensitivity labels and classification rules
Triage DLP incidents and escalate confirmed data leaks
Reduce false positives without missing real leaks
Work with data owners to define what is sensitive
Report on incidents and policy coverage

skills.expectation: Build and tune DLP policies in Purview, Forcepoint or Symantec
Deploy and manage endpoint DLP agents across the fleet
Protect regulated data in line with the DPDP Act and GDPR
Map data protection controls to ISO 27001 and similar standards
Configure sensitivity labels and policies in the Microsoft 365 estate
Triage DLP incidents and escalate confirmed data leaks
Reduce false positives without missing real leaks
Work with data owners and report incidents clearly
Align DLP rules with the data protection policy
Use CASB and web gateway controls for data in motion
Extend DLP to cloud storage and SaaS apps
Automate policy and reporting tasks with scripts

certifications.why: Security fundamentals for data protection roles
Microsoft Purview DLP is repeatedly asked for in DLP postings.
